relations: The striped fabric feeds steadily beneath the stationary presser foot, shifting its pattern relative to the foot.
The needle shaft displays slight vertical motion blur, indicating the machine is actively running.
The left hand enters, presses the fabric beside the foot, adjusts the edge, and lifts away to the upper-left.
The right hand rests flat to the right, guiding the continuous advance of the cloth.
caption: The video captures a close-up of a sewing machine's needle and presser-foot area as a green-and-white striped fabric feeds steadily beneath the lowered foot. A warm pool of light falls across the cloth. The operator's right hand rests flat to the right of the foot, fingers spread, guiding it along. The striped pattern shifts continuously relative to the stationary foot, and the needle shaft shows slight vertical motion blur, indicating the machine is running. At first only a forearm appears at the left edge, but the left hand soon enters and its thumb presses down on the fabric just beside the foot. This left hand repeatedly adjusts, smoothing and repositioning the striped edge, sometimes lifting into a blur before settling again. After these adjustments the left hand lifts away toward the upper-left and releases the cloth, while the right hand and the steady advance of the fabric continue unchanged.
